memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 95 kg, waist 102 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for men).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat 120 mg with each main meal; aim for 500 kcal deficit daily; start brisk walk 30 min 5×/week.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes triggered by lying flat, lasting <1 min, negative Dix‑Hallpike on right.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD; meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute vertigo.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: ALT 48 U/L (↑), AST 44 U/L (↑), mild hepatomegaly on exam.
  - Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; repeat LFT and ultrasound in 3 months.
- Breakfast: Replace sugary cereal with oats + nuts; no added sugar.
- Lunch: Whole‑grain roti, dal, plenty of vegetables; limit rice to 1 cup.
- Dinner: Grilled fish or paneer, salad, avoid fried foods.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-15.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 92 kg, waist 99 cm (>90).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat; add metformin 500 mg BD after meals for insulin resistance; reinforce diet.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Vertigo frequency reduced to 1‑2 episodes/week after betahistine; meclizine used SOS.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; consider vestibular rehab if no further improvement.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: ALT 42 U/L, AST 38 U/L (improving).
  - Plan: Continue silymarin and rosuvastatin; repeat LFT and ultrasound in 8 weeks.
- Breakfast: Oats with skim milk, walnuts, no sugar.
- Lunch: Multigrain roti, chickpea curry, steamed broccoli.
- Dinner: Grilled chicken, quinoa salad, avoid desserts.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-09-10.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 89 kg, waist 96 cm (>90).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat and metformin; aim for further 3 kg loss; add weekly resistance training.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Vertigo episodes <1/week, mild; meclizine used ≤2 times/month.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine; taper meclizine PRN.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: ALT 36 U/L, AST 34 U/L (within normal). Ultrasound shows grade I steatosis.
  - Plan: Continue silymarin; consider tapering rosuvastatin if lipids persist.
- Dyslipidaemia (noted under NAFLD)
  - Status: Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, LDL 115 mg/dL, TG 140 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Continue rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; repeat lipid profile in 3 months.
- Breakfast: Oats, flaxseed, skim milk.
- Lunch: Whole‑grain roti, lentil soup, salad.
- Dinner: Baked fish, brown rice, steamed vegetables.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-12-15.

- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 86 kg, waist 92 cm (>90).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat; discontinue metformin as HbA1c now normal; maintain activity.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: No vertigo spells in past 6 weeks; off betahistine for 2 weeks with no recurrence.
  - Plan: Stop betahistine; keep meclizine SOS only.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
